'''Republic Mobile Surgical Unit 3''' was a [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit/Legends|Republic Mobile Surgical Unit]] stationed on the jungle [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]. The [[Sea of Sponges]] was in between RMSU-3 and [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit 7|RMSU-7]]. It serviced the personnel of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] at the [[Battle of Drongar]] alongside other surgical units under the command of [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[D'Arc Vaetes]]. It, with all the other Republic forces on the planet, left when the [[Bota/Legends|bota]] mutated and became useless.

[[Tolk le Trene]], a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Nurse/Legends|nurse]], wanted to transfer to RMSU-3 from 7 in order to be away from her lover [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Jos Vondar]].<ref name="Jedi Healer" />
